title: KVQuant: Towards 10 Million Context Length LLM Inference with KV Cache Quantization
technique: KV cache quantization (per-channel/pre-RoPE keys, non-uniform, dense-and-sparse)

optimized_metrics.evidence: KV cache activations surface as the dominant contributor to memory consumption
we achieve<0.1 perplexity degradation with 3-bit quantization

headline_claim.text: Our method enables serving LLaMA-7B with a context length of up to 1 million on a single A100-80GB GPU and up to 10 million on an 8-GPU system

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. Kernel speedup (~1.7x vs fp16 matvec) is also reported.
